# Section 8 loaded tail, OM-5 1.2

0x7b8 bytes of 0xFF before section 8's loaded end; section 8 is copied second, after section 0.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x615e9848` to `0x615ea000` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>

**Build:** [om5 firmware 1.2, build 1200](../firmware/om5-1200.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-5](../cameras/om5.md)
